As always, there's always a simpler way ;) Thanks a million!

I did want to have two routers, though. It's easy to figure out what happens when the router is actively opening a session; I wanted to see what it does with an incoming one.

comments.html: Just wondering: wouldn’t a static ARP entry to a non-existent MAC address on a stub link be easier than creating two routers and messing with null routes, ACLs and dropping ICMP?
